content: iOS Safari PWA constraints 2025: Only display:standalone supported (no fullscreen). Status bar always visible - must use safe area insets. No beforeinstallprompt event (no auto install prompt). Storage eviction after weeks of non-use. EU users on iOS 17.4+ get browser-tab experience (no standalone). Must include apple-touch-icon and apple-touch-startup-image. navigator.standalone detects installed state. Wake Lock API works on iOS 16.4+.
